items.description: This game is a simulation of self-isolation.The game takes place in a fictional country called the Yublin Federation where people get sick with a virus called SOVID-19. You are in self isolation. Only you, your work, your wife, your daughter and 4 walls. Money and products is limited and melting away before our eyes. You work remotely from your computer to the government and you need to issue QR codes to the people to allow them to go out. On the first day of your work, a decree was issued that all people over 65 have to stay at home, therefore, you need to refuse to issue codes to them. With each passing day, the conditions for issuing are becoming tougher. Remember that you need to support your family, not to lose your job and finally not to go crazy.GAME FEATURES: ◆ An interactive story with a lot of choices ◆ Each day will be more difficult than the previous one ◆ The family you need to keep on self-isolation. items.description: Paradise Corner is a cozy and relaxing casual clicker game.After years of wandering, you finally return to your native land. Your garden, once lush and blooming, is now overgrown with weeds, the beds are bare, and pests roam every corner.But with your return, everything will change! A young man greets you at the door – a faithful helper who has held onto hope for your return all these years and carefully tended to what could still be saved. With his support and your determination, the journey to reviving the garden begins.Your task is to gradually, step by step, restore life and beauty to the garden. Destroy pests by clicking on them to protect the seedlings and allow future harvests to flourish without threat. Uproot the weeds, making room for new plantings and allowing the garden to bloom once again. Plant a variety of crops and eventually restore your garden's grandeur, filling it with vibrant flowers and a bountiful harvest!
